decisions.name: go-core-style
decisions.reason: Writing Go tests calls for idiomatic naming, formatting, error handling and standard-library use.

decisions.name: go-api-contracts
decisions.reason: Tests verify existing documented API and CLI behavior; they do not create or change either contract.

decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
decisions.reason: No production interface, dependency wiring, constructor, options API or resource lifecycle is changed.

decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
decisions.reason: Tests remain in the existing package and verify its existing responsibility; no package ownership or import direction changes.
